_note: Proposed by BE-P (FE-A) for F11-T12 and the pages that follow (D81, CLAUDE.md): text the club admin console needs that the A keys do not have. Numbers to be assigned by Content; wording drafted in Thai and English, writers own it. Variables follow locales/README.md. Existing keys reused by T12: A-0002 to A-0004, A-0102, A-0156 to A-0165, A-0488, A-0519 to A-0521, P-0326 to P-0328.
